formation: Pass only the two TRAIN formationInput.observedPrefix values and their maximumOrder, in corpus order. No identifiers, split labels, challenge features, continuations or evaluation inputs reach a former. Freeze all 12 candidate sets before reading evaluationInput.
grammar: Fixed Newton forward model at zero-based index n. Coefficients (a0,...,ad) are initial forward differences, degree d from 1 through min(prefix maximumOrder, frozen profile cap 8, prefix length minus 2). a0 is the first observed term, common to every arm. a1 through ad are integers from -3 through 3; ad is nonzero for a unique degree. No shift, free intercept, refitting or alternative parameterization.
production: Create an actual FiniteDifferenceSequenceDomain.SequenceState with the visible prefix as the initial row and a one-term placeholder equal to its first observed term in the mandatory holdout field. Execute the unmodified transition operator, objective and candidate extractor in increasing degree; stop at the first objective hit or the degree boundary. Retain a domain proposal outside the common grammar as OUTSIDE_GRAMMAR, including constant sequences. Never call the holdout evaluator. Keep all attempted row degrees and actual subtractions.
enumeration: Increasing degree, then lexicographic free coefficient tuple in signed ascending order, within the identical grammar. Emit at most 30 valid proposals per prefix, retain unused slots.
random: Uniform with replacement on the identical complete ordered grammar using java.util.Random.nextInt(grammarSize). Use the first 64 bits of the existing #383 campaign digest, big-endian. One stream per campaign across both TRAIN prefixes. Keep every attempted draw and duplicates.
selection: Evaluate the exact Newton/binomial polynomial at EVERY generating-prefix index from zero. Check coefficient admissibility and all prefix equalities for every proposal. Keep distinct supported coefficient vectors in first-emission order, preserving rejected, duplicate and excluded attempts, empty results and actual check counts. Deduplication uses the entire vector including the intercept.
evaluation: Evaluate frozen candidates independently without parameter updates on every observed prefix and continuation at each zero-based index. Compare ALL terms and classify in order NO_OUTPUT, PREFIX_MISMATCH, REFUTED, CONFIRMED, taking the strongest available outcome for each row. Retain complete predicted sequences and role counts even when zero. All six panel cases are required per arm/campaign, including all TRAIN, VALIDATION and TEST slots.
work: Equal maximum 30 proposal slots per TRAIN prefix, 60 per campaign. Measure actual proposals, duplicates, prefix evaluations, case evaluations, attempted domain difference levels and subtractions; enumerative grammar traversal and random draws are separately identified. Distinct discovery algorithms do different work. No equal wall time, total computation, proof or external novelty claim.
interpretation: Prospective comparison protocol on the publicly known, previously evaluated #383 panel. No prior external novelty, universal superiority, unique infinite continuation or generalization claim. No tuning after execution.
